summary: Gentherm filed an 8-K reporting the September 10, 2026 special meeting at which holders approved share issuance for its Reverse Morris Trust acquisition of Modine's Performance Technologies business. Under the January 29, 2026 Merger Agreement and Separation Agreement, Modine spins off the business to Platinum SpinCo, distributes SpinCo stock pro rata to Modine holders, and SpinCo merges into a Gentherm subsidiary, converting SpinCo shares into Gentherm common stock, making SpinCo wholly owned. Roughly 29,142,794 shares, about 94.8% of outstanding, were represented. Watch regulatory clearance and exchange-ratio adjustments.
